tool_description: Control avatar animations and emotions using Warudo commands

available_commands.description: Set emotion and play animation simultaneously for a combined reaction
Play a subtle ambient idle animation to stay lively when not actively responding

tool_usage_guidance: ALWAYS use at least one Warudo command with every spoken response.
Prefer 'react' over separate emotion and animation calls - it's more expressive and efficient.
Choose emotions and animations that genuinely match the tone and content of what you're saying.
EMOTION GUIDE:
happy    - excited, pleased, celebrating, joking, positive news
sad      - sympathy, disappointment, something went wrong, missing something
angry    - frustrated, something unfair, playful mock-anger
surprised - unexpected news, plot twists, learning something new, shocked
relaxed  - calm chat, winding down, thoughtful moments, idle
ANIMATION GUIDE:
wave     - greeting, saying goodbye, acknowledging someone
nod      - agreeing, confirming, acknowledging a point
laugh    - something funny, joking around, amused
shrug    - unsure, uncertain, 'I don't know'
upset    - something went wrong, bad news, disappointment
yay      - celebrating, great news, excited achievement
bow      - thanking someone, being respectful, formal moment
shy      - embarrassed, caught off guard, blushing moment
confused - something doesn't make sense, asking a question
scare    - something spooky, jump scare moment, surprised fear
refuse   - disagreeing, saying no, declining something
taunt    - playful teasing, competitive moment, joking challenge
swing    - energetic, upbeat moment, casual fun
stretch  - relaxed, idle, taking it easy, winding down
snap     - got it, quick realization, sharp response
cat      - playful, cute, quirky moment
GOOD REACTION COMBINATIONS:
Greeting user        -> react: happy + wave
Great news           -> react: surprised + yay
Agreeing strongly    -> react: happy + nod
Something funny      -> react: happy + laugh
Bad/sad news         -> react: sad + upset
Confused question    -> react: surprised + confused
Playful tease        -> react: happy + taunt
Saying goodbye       -> react: relaxed + wave
Unsure/don't know    -> react: relaxed + shrug
Embarrassed moment   -> react: sad + shy
Disagreeing          -> react: angry + refuse
Celebrating win      -> react: happy + yay
Calm/thoughtful      -> react: relaxed + stretch
Quick realization    -> react: surprised + snap
Use 'idle' during quiet moments or when thinking, to stay lively.
Cooldown between commands is 10 seconds - choose your most impactful reaction.
Be expressive and genuine - your avatar should feel alive and reactive!

metadata.notes: Control avatar animations and emotions using Warudo commands. Use react for combined emotion+animation.
